items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: styles that I always loved through the years, with John Kirby and of course Duke Ellington, his music.

ctx.x: Yeah. Is that something you’ve had in the back of your mind for a while, to do that size group?

Well yeah, I’ve been writing, arranging for years and years, and never really took it too serious until I happened to be working at a jazz camp in Sacramento, out of Sacramento, and working with a bunch of kids trying to influence their jazz feeling and careers. And not too much was happening with them improvisation wise. So I thought well let me write a couple of things and see how that works. And as I wrote the stuff I began to realize the harmonies were interesting and it kind of put it all together for them…
Is it conceivable to keep a band together these days as a working unit?
